name: Horikawa Hibiki
source:
"Now, call your oni here."

Appears 17 years old, actual age 131 years.
He's aiming for [url=/c44373]Kaki's[/url] life and he believes his weakpoint is his bride so he's going after the protagonist.
He's good looking, but he's a strong oni who is cruel and has a black heart.
He has no mercy for those he considers his enemy.
